text:
Situation: Morphine sulfate injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2017-10-31 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 2.7 days of 2 mg/mL 1 mL cartridges (56 units) while Corvale General holds 16.7 days (317 units) and can spare 51 units while retaining a two-week supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage listing names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC with current shortage status. FDA's OAI classification letter to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is dated 2017-12-28, 58 days after the shortage posting. Inspection 732653 at the Fresenius Kabi plant ended 2011-07-08 and was classified OAI with the classification known on 2017-12-28. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. also appears on the shortage list with current status; its registered plant was last inspected 2026-05-13 with NAI classification.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East's supply without new purchasing commitments. Alternate products from Hospira and Fresenius Kabi have prior clinical approvals but require pharmacist verification for concentration or vial changes.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 51 units of morphine sulfate 2 mg/mL, 1 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval plus a DEA Form 222 or CSOS order for this Schedule II substance.
2. If additional supply is needed, transfer 47 units of 1 mg/mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval plus a DEA Form 222 or CSOS order.
3. Evaluate alternate concentration or vial size from Hospira, Inc. (approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-08-13) — requires pharmacist verification.
4. Evaluate alternate NDC from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (approved by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2025-10-09) — requires pharmacist verification.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Civica, Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no identifiable plant.
